jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A jau5 ngai4 him2

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial construction for putting a person or thing in danger.

examples.english: Crossing the road recklessly can endanger the kids.
examples.traditional: 亂咁過馬路會搞到啲細路有危險。
examples.jyutping: lyun6 gam2 gwo3 maa5 lou6 wui5 gaau2 dou3 dik1 sai3 lou6 jau5 ngai4 him2
